nodes.label: Bitboard search
nodes.contributor: Both engines search on a compact bitboard position for speed; the char-based board is used only for rules and rendering.

nodes.label: Automated AI training (hill-climbing self-play)
nodes.contributor: Built-in hill-climbing self-play loop tunes the Negamax evaluation weights.

nodes.label: Forced/free moves rule
nodes.contributor: The cell picked determines the opponent's next small board; a finished target board grants a free move.

nodes.label: Depth-parity evaluation bug
nodes.contributor: evaluate() scored from a fixed root-mover perspective while negamax negates each ply; at odd depths the frontier was scored from the wrong side, inverting the value. Fixed by evaluating from the side to move: evaluate(st, st.to_move=='X', w).

nodes.label: Random-opponent benchmark methodology
nodes.contributor: Each config plays fixed games vs random, alternating first mover to remove first-move bias; metric win-rate = (wins+0.5*draws)/games.

nodes.label: LLM coding behavioral guidelines
nodes.contributor: Think before coding, simplicity first, surgical changes, goal-driven execution.
